The AWP bow skin of Arcanic Visuals is made from the AWP of CS+ 1.3.1-hotfix2
(csplus-1.3.1-hotfix2.jar): its gun and scope models, textures, animations and sounds.

Changes made (tools/csplus_awp.py):
- the scope model is mounted on the gun's scope_pos bone and merged into one model;
- the gun and scope textures are packed into one atlas;
- only the draw, shoot, inspect, idle and run animations are kept, their sound cues renamed,
  and the shot sound is cued at the start of the shoot animation;
- the shoot animation keeps only its kick (gun and view); the bolt worked after a shot is a new
  "bolt" animation cut from the bolt stretch of the draw animation;
- the Blockbench hand stand-ins are removed and an aim_view bone is added at the scope's eye point.

These assets are used for a free, non-commercial mod. CS+ is not an official Valve or
Counter-Strike product, and neither is this skin.
